title: Siege of Besançon
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Besançon", at revision 1370739559, opens: "The siege of Besançon took place from 25 April to 22 May 1674 during the Franco-Dutch War, when French forces nominally led by Louis XIV invaded Franche-Comté, then part of the Spanish Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3485843, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1674 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
